scopeLimits: The WUP point is a population-cluster locator, not an official city boundary or parcel identity. A viewer, service description, metadata record, or clipped vector tile does not verify a full parcel polygon. No owner or personal data was requested or saved; no login, CAPTCHA, credential, or token was used.
name: Manaus
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Manaus city hall documents the Mapa de Manaus cadastral update (about 345,000 properties updated; project target around 524,000 units) and SEMEF GIS data. A public Geo360 lot vector-tile table and municipal ArcGIS lot layer are discoverable, but complete exact parcel geometries/counts and formal linkage to the city project were not verified.

officialSources.observation: Official Prefeitura report says Mapa de Manaus updated about 345,000 properties and added roughly 10,000. Property-update count is not a verified GIS feature count.
Official project progress report describes ~85% completion, roughly 345,000 updates and a target of about 524,000 units across the mapped urban area.

Official city material names Topocart as contractor. A Topocart article says it implemented Geo360 for the municipal project; this makes vendor-hosted Geo360 a plausible candidate but does not technically prove the exposed tenant table is the official project layer.

Official municipal ArcGIS layer metadata indexed as “Lotes - SEMEF”, polygon geometry, query support and ID/status fields. Direct bounded inspection timed out; no live count or feature sample obtained.

Public anonymous MapLibre layer viewer, loaded with MapLibre JS and jQuery from public CDN. It displays the vector-tile table; no bearer-token/CSRF bootstrap marker was found. Tile availability does not prove complete parcel geometry.

candidateSources.operator: Geo360; likely related to Mapa de Manaus vendor work, linkage not technically confirmed
candidateSources.assessment: Strong public polygon-layer candidate. Metadata and one capped tile were obtained; no full feature geometry or total count verified.
Official candidate; direct service request timed out; no live result.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Municipal cadastral mapping project documented citywide by the Prefeitura; a vendor-hosted vector-tile table has a metadata extent covering the WUP locator. Actual feature coverage, count, and public map-service coverage remain unverified.

research.blocker: A vector-tile table and official polygon MapServer candidate are discoverable, but neither yielded complete exact parcel geometries in this pass. The official MapServer and project viewer hosts timed out; Geo360 remains a plausible, not technically confirmed, project-layer candidate.
research.remainingUncertainty: The official project viewer/app direct host and the city ArcGIS host timed out on retry. Geo360 layer metadata and MapLibre viewer are public without auth, but only a clipped/quantized tile was observed; full feature access and the table’s formal linkage to Mapa de Manaus remain unverified.
